abstract: Crossing the threshold from trial to sovereignty: architecting autonomous AI ecosystems, guiding KidsLab, and codifying the Library of Kairosis. Returning from fifteen years across corporate IT, agency scale, and multi-agent systems to sovereign ground in El Salvador—carrying the flame as builder, strategist, and teacher.
